name: #5039: a waiver whose reason cites its issue on the line below the lint's name is cited
#5039: a waiver whose reason cites no issue is listed with no citation
#5039: a waiver on one line carries its citation on that line
head:
#[expect(spec_clause_traversal, reason = "whole table, #12")]
fn f() {}

name: #5039: an `economy:` comment cites its issue on a continuation line, and its extent ends at the next item's head

output.text: /// - economy: scans the whole stream on each edit;

name: #5039: the lint's name outside an `expect(` or `allow(` is no waiver
head:
// The spec_clause_traversal lint reads this body.
fn f() {}

name: #5039: a waiver the change leaves as it stands is not the change's ceiling
#6890: a ceiling the change moves, at another indent, is not the change's ceiling
#6890: a new ceiling beside a moved one is the change's ceiling
